integrity_statement: All spectral identities are exact; computation checks arithmetic and does not substitute for the infinite-mode argument.
scientific_limitations: Local linear Fourier analysis of a nonlocal advection-diffusion model; nonlinear persistent oscillations, global dynamics, and historical priority are not proved. A related 2020 full text was not accessible.
title: A sharp three-phenotype threshold for oscillatory nonlocal aggregation with positive net attraction
